purpose: Teach: コンビネーション/クズ/適格/供与/にあたり/勲章/公聴/意匠

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、製品のコンビネーション戦略を成功させた
lines.en: Your father, in his younger days, made a real success of his product combination strategy.
lines.style: Slow reminiscent opening, gaze somewhere in the distance, each word placed with quiet respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはクズ材、つまりクズ素材リサイクル事業を始められた
lines.en: Yes. Father started the scrap business — recycling waste materials, that is.
lines.style: Measured, reverent agreement, the clarification handled gently, pride kept just beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、適格な人材登用に拘られた
lines.en: Your father, back then, insisted on promoting only truly qualified people.
lines.style: Wistful, admiring cadence, slowing on the word 'insisted', a faint smile of memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは取引先への供与を惜しまれなかった
lines.en: Yes. Father never held back when it came to giving to our business partners.
lines.style: Low, thoughtful affirmation at a steady pace, a son measuring himself against the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、契約締結にあたり、慎重を期された
lines.en: Your father, when he was young, took every precaution before putting his name to a contract.
lines.style: Deliberate elder's rhythm with a long pause mid-line, the lesson offered rather than pressed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員勲章授与制度を整えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father was the one who established the employee decoration system.
lines.style: Quiet and composed, warmth flickering through the formal phrasing on 'Father'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、公聴会への出席を厭われなかった
lines.en: Your father, in those days, never once shied away from attending a public hearing.
lines.style: Gently emphatic, admiration deepening, voice dropping toward a hush on the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは意匠、つまり意匠登録の重要性を説かれた
lines.en: Yes. Father always preached the importance of design — of registering our designs, that is.
lines.style: Settled, conclusive close, a slow nod almost audible, carrying the lesson forward with resolve.
